title: My Message Matters
subtitle: An illustrated guide to everyday communication
statusDetail: The PDF edition is prepared. Online purchase and delivery are not yet available.
hook: Understand the message. Make room for the next one.
shortDescription: Pinnacle Blooms Network’s Speech & Communication 101 parent guide: 31 illustrated pages on gestures, words, AAC, choices and everyday family communication.
description:
My Message Matters is the Speech & Communication 101 illustrated parent guide from Pinnacle Blooms Network, by Dr. Koti Reddy Saripalli and Dr. Sreeja Reddy Saripalli. Its 31 core pages explore everyday communication through gestures, sounds, words, pictures and established augmentative and alternative communication (AAC).

Explore familiar play, real choices, comfortable response time, shared books, family languages and useful messages such as help, stop, more and finished. The emphasis is on responding to meaning and keeping communication available, including established augmentative and alternative communication (AAC).

For parents and caregivers looking for speech and language support ideas to discuss and share in everyday routines, including families supporting a child with speech delay or different communication needs.

The English PDF contains 45 file pages: 31 core learning pages, nine shared PinnacleAI and Verify information pages, one discipline-specific service page, two covers and two blank pages. 101 is an introductory volume label, not a count of activities. Designed for adult-guided sharing; select ideas to suit the child’s development, comfort and access. General educational information; individual professional advice may be needed. The book purchase does not include therapy, assessment or software access.
features: 31 picture-led pages on communication in ordinary family routines.
Welcome gestures, sounds, speech, pictures and established AAC.
Explore choices, shared play, books and comfortable response time.
Use practical ideas for meals, dressing, washing and familiar visits.
Includes nine PinnacleAI and Verify information pages and a speech-therapy service page.

faqs.question: What is My Message Matters?

Its 31 core pages explore everyday communication through gestures, sounds, words, pictures and established augmentative and alternative communication (AAC).

faqs.question: Does 101 mean 101 activities?
faqs.answer: No. 101 is the introductory volume label. This book contains 31 core learning pages.

faqs.question: What comes with the digital book?
faqs.answer: One English-language, full-colour landscape PDF with 45 file pages. It contains 31 learning pages, nine PinnacleAI and Verify information pages, one service page, two covers and two blank pages. No therapy sessions, assessment or software subscription are included.

faqs.question: What ages is it intended to support?
faqs.answer: The collection is intended for adults supporting early childhood, including children aged about 9 months to 7 years. Select ideas individually; this is not a claim that every page suits every age. The book is an adult-guided resource, not an independent reading-level book for infants.

faqs.question: Is the book relevant to autism, ADHD or developmental differences?
faqs.answer: Families supporting autistic children, children with ADHD, speech delay or developmental differences may find relevant everyday ideas. Relevance depends on the child and the page; the book does not diagnose or treat a condition.

faqs.question: Does the book include treatment or PinnacleAI access?
faqs.answer: No. The purchase is for the selected book edition. The PinnacleAI and Verify section explains the organisation’s ecosystem and evidence resources. Clinical services and software access are separate.

faqs.answer: Yes. Each has 31 discipline-specific learning pages. The nine PinnacleAI and Verify information pages are shared across all four volumes.

faqs.question: Does my child need to speak to use this book?
faqs.answer: No. My Message Matters welcomes gestures, sounds, pictures, words and established AAC. An adult can share the illustrated pages without expecting the child to read or say a word.

description:
Understanding Everyday Behaviour is the ABA Parent Education 101 illustrated guide from Pinnacle Blooms Network, by Dr. Koti Reddy Saripalli and Dr. Sreeja Reddy Saripalli. Its 31 core pages help adults notice communication, comfort, choices and the surrounding situation before deciding how to respond.
